then.text: Come back in a year and I'll have more. Cheese does not respond to being rushed, and neither do I.

else.text: You rolled the block! Nobody does on the first try. The cheeses in here are cloth-bound cheddars, turned by hand and left in the dark to think about things.
The Affineur wraps three wedges of cave-aged cheddar and presses them into your hands.
